repos.description: 一个基于 JavaScript 的网盘文件下载地址获取工具。基于【网盘直链下载助手】修改 ，支持 百度网盘 / 阿里云盘 / 中国移动云盘 / 天翼云盘 / 迅雷云盘 / 夸克网盘 / UC网盘 / 123云盘 八大网盘
repos.summary_zh: LinkSwift是一款基于JavaScript的网盘直链下载助手，支持百度、阿里、移动、天翼、迅雷、夸克、UC、123云盘等八大主流网盘。通过注入脚本解析页面请求，绕过客户端限制，直接获取文件下载地址，提升下载效率。适用于批量下载或高速下载，亮点为多网盘适配、持续更新、开源免费。
repos.summary_en: LinkSwift is a JavaScript-based cloud drive direct link downloader supporting eight major cloud drives including Baidu, Aliyun, China Mobile, Tianyi, Xunlei, Quark, UC, and 123pan. By injecting scripts to parse page requests, it bypasses client restrictions and directly obtains file download URLs, improving download efficiency. Suitable for batch or high-speed downloads, featuring multi-drive compatibility, continuous updates, and open-source free.

repos.description: 📻Free and open-sourced terminal/ssh/sftp/ftp/telnet/serialport/RDP/VNC/Spice client(Linux, Mac, Windows, Android, HarmonyOS, iOS)
repos.summary_zh: electerm 是一款开源的跨平台终端与远程连接客户端，集成 SSH/SFTP/FTP/Telnet/串口/RDP/VNC 等多种协议。支持 Windows、macOS、Linux（含 ARM64），提供全局热键、透明窗口、背景图片等特性。内置 AI 助手（DeepSeek/OpenAI）与 MCP 协议支持，实现命令建议与工具集成。通过 Zmodem/Trzsz 实现文件传输，并可将配置同步至 GitHub/Gitee Gist，是开发者管理远程服务器的全能工具。
repos.summary_en: electerm is an open-source, cross-platform terminal and remote connection client that consolidates SSH, SFTP, FTP, Telnet, serial port, RDP, VNC, and Spice protocols into a single application. Built on Electron, it supports Windows, macOS, and Linux (including ARM64 architectures). Key features include global hotkeys for instant access, transparent windows, terminal background images, and integrated AI assistants (DeepSeek, OpenAI) via MCP protocol for command suggestions and script generation. It facilitates file transfers through Zmodem and Trzsz, supports SSH tunneling and proxy configurations, and allows synchronization of bookmarks and settings to GitHub/Gitee Gist, making it a versatile tool for developers and system administrators managing remote infrastructure.

repos.description: Gradio WebUI for creators and developers, featuring key TTS (Edge-TTS, kokoro) and zero-shot Voice Cloning (E2 & F5-TTS, CosyVoice), with Whisper audio processing, YouTube download, Demucs vocal isolation, and multilingual translation.
repos.summary_zh: Voice-Pro是集YouTube视频下载、人声分离、语音识别、多语言翻译与TTS于一体的AI音频创作平台。基于Gradio构建，集成Whisper、F5-TTS、CosyVoice等前沿模型，支持零样本语音克隆与高质量配音，为创作者提供一站式多语言内容本地化解决方案，显著提升跨语言内容生产效率。
repos.summary_en: Voice-Pro is an all-in-one AI audio creation platform that seamlessly integrates YouTube video downloading, vocal isolation, speech recognition, multilingual translation and text-to-speech capabilities. Built on Gradio with cutting-edge models including Whisper, F5-TTS, E2-TTS and CosyVoice, it enables zero-shot voice cloning and professional-grade dubbing. The platform provides creators and developers with a comprehensive solution for multilingual content localization, significantly enhancing cross-lingual content production efficiency.

repos.description: A script allowing you to download images and videos from Telegram web even if the group restricts downloading.
repos.summary_zh: 该脚本是一款Telegram网页端用户脚本，可突破群组下载限制，实现图片、视频、GIF及音频等媒体的无损下载。支持私聊、频道及故事内容，通过注入页面解锁下载按钮，兼容主流浏览器及脚本管理器。无需后端服务，适用于需备份Telegram受限媒体资源的用户。
repos.summary_en: This user script bypasses Telegram web's download restrictions to save images, videos, GIFs, and audios from chats, stories, and private channels. It injects into pages to unlock download buttons, compatible with major browsers via script managers like Tampermonkey. Lightweight and backend-free, it efficiently backs up restricted Telegram media content.

repos.description: Fast, native Rust + GPUI workspace for local and SSH with MCP tools—no WebView, no telemetry, open source.
repos.summary_zh: OxideTerm 是一款基于 Tauri 2 和纯 Rust SSH 实现的一体化终端工作台，将本地 Shell、SSH、SFTP、远程 IDE 和 AI 代理集成于单一原生二进制文件中。其核心技术亮点包括智能重连、连接复用、MCP 协议与 RAG 知识库的 AI 集成，以及无 Electron、无 OpenSSL 的轻量化架构，为开发者和运维人员提供高效、稳定的跨平台远程开发体验。
repos.summary_en: OxideTerm is an all-in-one terminal workspace built with Tauri 2 and pure Rust SSH, integrating local shells, SSH, SFTP, remote IDE, and AI agent into a single native binary. Key technical highlights include smart reconnection, connection multiplexing, MCP protocol with RAG-based AI integration, and a lightweight architecture without Electron or OpenSSL, delivering efficient and stable cross-platform remote development experience for developers and operations teams.

repos.description: High-performance native SSH client in Rust, GPU-rendered with GPUI: host manager, terminal, WinSCP-style SFTP and port forwarding. Rust 编写、GPU 渲染的原生 SSH 客户端。
repos.summary_zh: ShellRS 是一款 Rust 编写的高性能跨平台原生 SSH 客户端，基于 GPUI 实现 GPU 渲染界面。集成 Xshell 风格主机管理、WinSCP 风格 SFTP 文件传输及端口转发，支持多级跳板与代理连接，无 Electron 依赖，并提供 CLI 供 AI 智能体调用。
repos.summary_en: ShellRS is a high-performance, cross-platform native SSH client written in Rust, featuring GPU-accelerated rendering powered by the GPUI framework from the Zed editor. It unifies Xshell-style host management, tabbed terminals, WinSCP-style dual-pane SFTP file transfer, and SSH port forwarding into a single integrated window. The client supports multi-level jump hosts, HTTP and SOCKS5 proxy connections, and stores credentials securely in the system keychain. With no Electron or JVM dependencies, it delivers native performance. A built-in CLI tool also enables AI agents like Claude Code to execute commands and transfer files on saved hosts.

repos.description: 👏 Make learning a lifelong habit. 学无止境
repos.summary_zh: my-geektime 是极客时间VIP课程的音视频私有化部署系统。支持一次缓存永久观看，一键发布课程为在线文档，以及本地音视频下载。基于Docker容器化技术，提供跨平台部署能力，实现学习资源的离线管理与在线访问，适合构建个人终身学习知识库。
repos.summary_en: my-geektime is a self-hosted GeekTime VIP course platform specializing in audio/video resource management. It enables permanent offline viewing through one-time caching, one-click online documentation publishing, and local media downloads. Built with Docker containerization for cross-platform deployment (amd64/arm64), it transforms streaming content into private learning assets. This tool eliminates dependency on official servers, providing lifelong access to purchased courses while maintaining content organization, search capabilities, and seamless playback functionality for individual learners.
